properties.name: Void deck, Blk 177 Toa Payoh Central
properties.notes: Sheltered, step-free void deck in the busiest HDB town centre; heavy foot traffic from the bus interchange and hawker centre. Bishan-Toa Payoh Town Council lets residents book void decks and open spaces (variety shows are not permitted at void decks; open spaces are an option).
properties.source: OneMap search (SLA), location checked 31 Oct 2026; Bishan-Toa Payoh Town Council booking page (btptc.org.sg)

properties.name: Community plaza, Kampung Admiralty
properties.notes: Sheltered plaza at an HDB integrated development (homes for seniors, medical centre, hawker centre). Good for intergenerational programmes in Woodlands.

properties.name: Our Tampines Hub — community plaza
properties.notes: Large integrated community hub with an outdoor plaza beside the town park. Managing agency for event use not confirmed — check before planning.

properties.name: Haji Lane, Kampong Glam
properties.notes: Narrow shophouse lane known for murals and independent shops; strong arts identity inside the Kampong Glam conservation area. Any use of the road needs the road authority's agreement.

properties.name: Bussorah Street pedestrian mall, Kampong Glam
properties.notes: Pedestrianised street framed by conserved shophouses with Sultan Mosque as a backdrop; already used for festive bazaars and street events.

properties.name: Bishan-Ang Mo Kio Park — River Plains
properties.notes: Open lawns along the naturalised Kallang River; a regional park popular with families in the evening.

properties.name: Punggol Waterway Park
properties.notes: Waterfront park at the heart of a young HDB town; boardwalks and lawns suit light installations seen after dark.

properties.name: Jurong Lake Gardens — Passion Wave lawn
properties.notes: National gardens in the west with lakeside lawns; NParks lists a dedicated contact for Jurong Lake Gardens venue enquiries.

properties.name: Esplanade Park
properties.notes: Waterfront park in the Civic District next to the arts centre; high footfall, heritage memorials nearby.

properties.name: Forecourt, former Tanjong Pagar Railway Station
properties.notes: 1932 railway station (national monument) at the southern end of the Rail Corridor; dramatic setting for heritage-led arts. Land owner and access conditions to be confirmed.

properties.name: Dakota Crescent (former SIT estate)
properties.notes: 1950s estate with its well-known dove playground; residents moved out and part of the estate is being redeveloped. Current owner and access are unknown — a test of how the tool handles gaps.

properties.name: Siglap Linear Park
properties.notes: Neighbourhood linear park between landed estates in the east; quiet, suits small acoustic sets and workshops.
